**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The Agreement imposes no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant on Mortgage Logic.com. Searches across the full document for "solicit", "employ or engage", "no-hire", "induce", "recruit", "hire", "staff" and "personnel" produced no responsive covenant:

- **§ 8 (Covenants and Warranties of Client)** — the planner's primary candidate — is confined to compliance with laws, the underwriting-decision notification, limitation on access to the Interface, the Credit Data licence, Client Content representations, and TrueLink's anti-spamming right.
- **§ 10 (Confidentiality)** — the second candidate — closes with the standard disclosure exceptions and contains no employee-related restriction.
- The only "unsolicited" language (§ 7) relates to commercial e-mail, not employees.

This sits at the preferred position ("Customer has no non-solicitation restriction"), so no redline was proposed. Watch-item only: if TrueLink later proposes a non-solicit, hold it to the fallback (mutual, personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from end of involvement, general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, no no-hire).
